key: CORIN-ROUGE: Ah, fair lady!
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Ah, fair lady!
ja: コリン・ルージュ: ああ、麗しのお嬢様!

key: A lesser man would blush-- nay, melt-- at the thought of such a beautiful soul pursuing him so fiercely...
en: A lesser man would blush-- nay, melt-- at the thought of such a beautiful soul pursuing him so fiercely...
ja: 凡庸な男なら赤面する――いや、とろけてしまうだろう、これほど美しい魂にかくも熱く追われるとあっては……

key: But though I am, as ever, truly and utterly moved by your devotion to me, I'm afraid I must go on!
en: But though I am, as ever, truly and utterly moved by your devotion to me, I'm afraid I must go on!
ja: だが、いつも通り、あなたの献身には心から深く感動しているとも――しかし、先を急がねばならぬ!

key: Tragic as it is, we can never truly be together, my lady,
en: Tragic as it is, we can never truly be together, my lady,
ja: 悲劇ではあるが、我々が真に結ばれることは決してない、お嬢様、

key: And thanks to the power of Hoopa's portals, we never shall!
en: And thanks to the power of Hoopa's portals, we never shall!
ja: そしてフーパの門の力のおかげで、これからもそうはならないだろう!

key: Save yourself the heartache, my lady! Abandon chase now!
en: Save yourself the heartache, my lady! Abandon chase now!
ja: 心痛を味わわずに済むよう、お嬢様、今すぐ追跡をお諦めなさい!

key: After all, with my wit, I've already stolen both of the orbs, and I've got them-- right here!
en: After all, with my wit, I've already stolen both of the orbs, and I've got them-- right here!
ja: 何しろ、この機知で、すでに両方の宝珠を盗み出した――ほら、ここにあるとも!

key: CORIN-ROUGE: Give it up!
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Give it up!
ja: コリン・ルージュ: 諦めるがいい!

key: With Hoopa's portals on my side, you haven't a hope of catching me!
en: With Hoopa's portals on my side, you haven't a hope of catching me!
ja: フーパの門が味方についている以上、貴殿に私を捕まえる望みなどない!

key: And I still have both of the orbs-- right here!
en: And I still have both of the orbs-- right here!
ja: そして両方の宝珠は、まだこの通り、ここにある!

key: Wait, where did the Blue Orb go...?
en: Wait, where did the Blue Orb go...?
ja: 待て、あいいろのたまはどこへ……?

key: CORIN-ROUGE: ...
en: CORIN-ROUGE: ...
ja: コリン・ルージュ: ……

key: Forget it.
en: Forget it.
ja: 忘れてくれ。

key: ...I've still got the Red Orb, right here!
en: ...I've still got the Red Orb, right here!
ja: ……べにいろのたまは、まだここにあるとも!

key: Though no jewel would compare to a visage such as yours-- I'll take this victory nonetheless!
en: Though no jewel would compare to a visage such as yours-- I'll take this victory nonetheless!
ja: いかなる宝石も、あなたのかんばせには及ばぬだろうが――それでもこの勝利はいただいていくとしよう!

key: And though to sail away from a sight as sweet as you does my heart no favors, I nevertheless must.
en: And though to sail away from a sight as sweet as you does my heart no favors, I nevertheless must.
ja: これほど甘美な姿から船出することは、我が心に何の恩恵ももたらさぬが、それでも去らねばならぬ。

key: A fantastic getaway yet awaits!
en: A fantastic getaway yet awaits!
ja: 見事な逃走劇が、まだ我を待っている!

key: I pray you save yourself the heartache, my lady, and abandon pursuit now!
en: I pray you save yourself the heartache, my lady, and abandon pursuit now!
ja: お嬢様、どうか心痛を味わわずに、今すぐ追跡をお諦めあれ!

key: A flatterer though I may be, you'll find me quite hard to get.
en: A flatterer though I may be, you'll find me quite hard to get.
ja: 我は口が上手いかもしれぬが、そう容易くは捕まらぬぞ。

key: We can run through altered space all day, \PN!
en: We can run through altered space all day, \PN!
ja: 一日中でも、ゆがんだ空間を駆け抜けてやろうではないか、\PN!

key: Save yourself the effort and head home now!
en: Save yourself the effort and head home now!
ja: 無駄な労力を使わず、今すぐ家に帰るがいい!

key: May we meet again, never!
en: May we meet again, never!
ja: また会うことなど、決してないように!
